"THE SAUGANASH HOTEL." — wood engraving, in A. T. Andreas, History of Chicago, vol. 1 (Chicago: A. T. Andreas, 1884), p. 632, in the chapter "Wolf Point and Early Hotels". A copyright line reading "A. T. Andreas, 188-" is lettered inside the plate border at the lower left.
